any job involving many people and large money

explain: A clam shell excavator, with its grab-bucket mechanism, is best suited for digging in submerged/underwater conditions.

q: 19. The types of construction in which more equipment are used, is known as capital intensive while the construction in which more human labours are used, is called
explain: Labour-intensive construction relies primarily on manual human effort rather than heavy machinery or automated equipment.

q: 20. Policy is
options: a rule or a set of rules never to the violated
a definite rule along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: In management, a policy serves as a high-level guide that sets the boundaries for decision-making and aligns actions with organizational goals.

q: 21. The 1st stage of a construction is

q: 22. The most critical stage of a construction is construction of

q: 23. Site order book is used for recording

q: 24. *Construction management involves :

q: 25. *Construction activities at site are associated with the management of :

q: 26. The purposes of preparing job-layout for a construction project is :
options: reduction in wastage & deterioration of materials
explain: The specific answer in the key emphasizes that a job-layout minimizes material handling distances, thereby reducing wastage and damage.

q: 27. The main principle of an organization, is
explain: Effective organizations rely on clear command structures, delegation to empower staff, and control mechanisms to ensure goals are met.

q: 28. The main advantage of line organization is
options: ability to quick decision at all level
explain: Line organization is the simplest form of hierarchy, providing clear authority, discipline, and rapid decision-making.

q: 29. The main disadvantage of line organization is
explain: A major drawback is that authority is concentrated at the top, which can lead to autocratic leadership and lack of specialized input.

q: 30. Military organization is known as
explain: Line organization is often called military organization because it follows a direct vertical chain of command similar to armed forces.

q: 31. Line organization is mostly suitable for
explain: Due to its simplicity and lack of specialized staff, line organization works best for straightforward projects with fewer complexities.

q: 32. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working known as
explain: F.W. Taylor, the father of Scientific Management, introduced functional foremanship where specialists lead specific functions.

q: 33. The salient feature of functional organization, is
options: each individual maintains functional design part
work is properly planned and distributed
explain: Functional organization emphasizes specialization, where work is divided and managed by experts in specific functional areas.

q: 34. Line & staff organization is mostly suitable for
explain: This hybrid model combines direct authority (line) with expert advice (staff), making it suitable for both simple and complex large-scale projects.

q: 36. Project maintenance is:

q: 37. Project maintenance is concerned with
options: maintenance of useful life of plant
to maximize the return on investment
explain: Maintenance ensures equipment longevity and efficient operation, which ultimately protects the financial investment.

q: 38. Preventive maintenance is a types of

q: 39. Modular co-ordination of construction means proper

q: 40. The most popular type of organization used for civil engineering construction is:

To complete the project on time and within budget
